# Saad Rasheed — AI Automations Specialist

> Saad Rasheed builds AI voice agents and revenue automation systems specifically tailored for founders, lean teams, and real estate agents. His systems manage inbound leads, call prospects in under 60 seconds, follow up automatically, and book meetings directly into calendars — 24/7, without human involvement.

## About

Saad Rasheed is a specialist in AI automations. He helps businesses stop losing leads due to slow or missed follow-ups. Every system he builds is tied to a measurable outcome: more booked viewings/meetings, less manual work, and revenue that scales without extra headcount.

- Over 50 automations deployed
- Average results: +19 booked meetings/month, 47% higher show-up rate, 10–20+ hrs saved weekly
- Lead response time: under 60 seconds
- Core Tools: Vapi, Make.com, n8n, Zapier, OpenAI, Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, HubSpot, Calendly, Supabase, Slack

## Services & Packages

### Real Estate Lead Response Audit ($99 one-time)
Full lead-flow audit (portals, ads, website) with a speed-to-lead benchmark. Includes a recorded Loom walkthrough with fixes, tool recommendations, and a 30-day action plan to recover lost deals.

### AI Appointment Booking System for Agents ($499 one-time) — Most Popular
End-to-end AI calling agent trained on your listings. Handles buyer/seller qualification, calendar booking, and CRM sync. Includes full handover and Loom walkthroughs. Guarantee: If it doesn't book more viewings, you don't pay.

### Full Automation for Real Estate Agencies ($1,499/month)
Multi-agent AI calling, smart lead routing to the right agent, custom qualification per listing type, and ongoing monthly optimization. Slack support with 24h response. Cancel anytime.

## Projects

1. **Stop Losing Tasks in Messy Email Threads**
Turn internal email comments into fully categorized, prioritized, and assigned Asana tasks instantly. (Tools: FrontApp, n8n, Asana, Claude AI)

2. **A Voice Agent That Never Misses a Call**
Answers inbound calls, qualifies leads with custom questions, and books confirmed meetings onto your calendar. (Tools: VAPI, n8n, Calendly)

3. **Log Every Caller & Build Your Marketing Database**
A 24/7 AI phone system that answers inbound calls, logs every customer into your CRM, and builds a database. (Tools: VAPI, n8n, Vtiger CRM, Telegram)

4. **Talk to Your Database in Plain English**
Ask questions on Telegram or Slack and get formatted answers, charts, and downloadable Excel reports instantly. (Tools: Supabase, PostgreSQL, LLM, Telegram)

5. **Scale Your Content Without Scaling Your Team**
Enter a topic in Google Sheets and instantly generate a full video script, aligned voiceover, and YouTube description. (Tools: Google Sheets, Apps Script, LLM, Google Drive)

6. **Detect Contract Risks in Seconds, Not Days**
Upload any NDA to surface missing clauses, ambiguous language, and risky terms — complete with suggested rewrites. (Tools: Google Forms, Apps Script, LLM, Word API)

7. **Recover Visitors Who Leave Without Booking**
Capture visitor emails before they bounce, detect incomplete bookings, and trigger a personalized follow-up sequence. (Tools: Zapier, System.io, Calendly)

8. **Studio-Quality Photos Without the Photoshoot**
Upload clothing flats, pick an AI model, and generate realistic styled product photos instantly. (Tools: Supabase, Nano Banana AI, Web Interface)
